_what: The next commitment's countdown for the Mac menu bar item (src/workspace/next-commitment.ts): which Calendar items count, how far ahead, and the words. `look_ahead_minutes` is the most the Calendar is read ahead (the widest the person can choose); `default_within_hours` is how far ahead counts until the person chooses (the menu bar setting, macos/App/menu-bar-panel.json settings), 0 meaning the rest of today only. `{what}` is the item's title and `{when}` is the countdown.
